text: The last man on Earth finally got a phone call. Eight billion people, gone. Just him and a cat. And the cat didn't like him. After three years of silence, his phone rang. He cried. He answered. Hello? Is anyone out there? We've been trying to reach you about your car's extended warranty. It was a robot. Humanity was gone. The robocalls survived. What's the last thing you'd say to it?
